readiness.title: Invoice readiness
readiness.heading: Do the clients' invoices already carry IBS/CBS?
readiness.lede: The Presumido and Real clients, by the invoices they issued in the last 30 days: who {firmShort} has to warn before the rejection.
readiness.note: Read from the XMLs imported under Management › Invoices. An invoice is complete when every item carries the IBS/CBS group, its CST and cClassTrib, and the 2026 test rates. OK at 95% or more with nothing at risk; Attention from 80% to 94%; Critical under 80% or with any invoice at risk of rejection 1115. Simples clients stay out until 2027.

suppliers.title: Supplier credit
suppliers.heading: How much credit does each client leave on the table?
suppliers.lede: From 2027, buying from Simples suppliers yields little IBS/CBS credit: which clients should review their suppliers.
suppliers.note: Read from the last 90 days' purchase invoices: each supplier's regime comes from the XML's CRT (1, 2 or 4 = Simples/MEI; 3 = standard regime). Credit lost a year = Simples purchases × 12 × (26.5% reference rate − the 3% to 5% a Simples supplier pays inside the DAS). An estimate, as a range: the reference rate and the DAS share are not final yet.
